claim: With NextReg $15 bit 6 = 0 the higher sprite number draws on top, so objects meant to sit behind others need lower numbers.

evidence.text: NextReg $15 bit 6 = 0 (reset value, never set): the higher sprite number is drawn on top; up to 116 sprites in all.
evidence.quote: Sprite priority: NextReg $15 bit 6 = 0 (reset value, never set): the HIGHER sprite number is drawn

evidence.text: NR 0x15 = 0x41 (bit 6 set) put sprite 0 on top and reversed the depth; the verifier painted later sprites last whatever the setup said, so it passed; 0x01 and a renderer that reads the setup fixed both.
evidence.quote: the depth reversed) and the verifier, painting later sprites last
